_note: M8 MAINNET: REAL FUNDS, about EUR 50 (plan approved by Ethan, 7 Nov 2026). Nothing here is a key. The strategy, limits and monitor settings come from xrpl.json, so live runs on the values frozen there (5 Nov). The hosts and issuer are also constants in live/guards.py: this file can't widen them.

offer_expiry._note: As on testnet (xrpl_testnet.json), whose values were measured on mainnet boundaries, 1-2 Nov 2026. Worst-case live time 60 s (Ethan, 4 Nov).

live._account: Ethan's dedicated Xaman account: its public address only, set when he gives it. The bot signs for it with its regular key, never the master key.
live._trust_line_limit_rlusd: The highest RLUSD trust line limit the bot starts with. Agreed as 100 (Ethan, 7 Nov 2026); raised by Ethan the same day (option 2) to Xaman's default, 751088147, which is what his line has: Xaman set it and he chose to keep it. Any higher limit still refuses to start. The limit only caps how much RLUSD the account can receive; the bot uses at most EUR 50 and pauses on money from outside.
live._max_account_eur: The whole account's worth at the start, above which the bot refuses to start: about EUR 60 is expected, and the bot uses EUR 50 of it (max_total_eur). Guards against the wrong account or funds added by mistake.
live._stop_at: Hard stop: Wed 11 Nov 2026 20:00 Irish time (GMT), Ethan 7 Nov 2026, recorded before any live order (results/m8_live_cutoff.txt). No run or resume after it; a running bot stops itself at it.
live._endpoints: The bot's own reads and sends, in order: it moves to the next when one stops answering. s2 first: the monitor reads xrplcluster.com, which has a per-IP quota. s1.ripple.com left out: it answered lgrNotFound for the validated ledger it had just reported. Checked 7 Nov 2026 (XRPL_VERIFICATION.md).
